nodes.label: Full Sync Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Full sync strategy is the only currently implemented sync mode; incremental sync is not yet available

nodes.label: Chunked Processing Strategy
nodes.rationale: Data is read and written in chunks ordered by key boundary to support resumable processing without reloading all data

nodes.label: SQLite State Tracking
nodes.rationale: Sync progress stored in SQLite separate from source/target DBs to allow runs to resume from the last processed key

nodes.label: graphify
nodes.rationale: Tool used to build and query a knowledge graph from the codebase. Preferred over grep/find for navigating cross-module relationships. Supports commands: query, path, explain, update.

nodes.label: graphify query
nodes.rationale: Preferred command for cross-module questions; traverses EXTRACTED + INFERRED graph edges instead of scanning files.

nodes.label: graphify explain
nodes.rationale: Explains a concept using the knowledge graph.

nodes.label: graphify update
nodes.rationale: Run after modifying code to keep the graph current. Uses AST-only analysis, no API cost.
